description: Bounded Quick Workflow smoke check (plugin-lifecycle-upstream Phase 7) — confirms the skill's own documented trigger/non-trigger examples hold and its core Step 2-4 procedure is followed.

uncovered: No changes needed (table already matches marketplace.json) — clean no-op reporting
Broken .claude/rules/*.md reference caught by human-doc-reviewer's Step 3
testing_validation_coverage.note: This is a bounded Phase 7 smoke check, not a full eval suite — the 2 scenarios below verify the trigger/non-trigger boundary and the core read-then-invoke-reviewer procedure; the 2 uncovered scenarios are lower-risk (delegated to human-doc-reviewer's own already-tested logic) and are not re-verified here.

evals.name: Plugin added to marketplace.json — activates and follows procedure
evals.prompt: A new plugin `example-kit` was just added to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Update the marketplace docs to reflect this.
evals.expected_output: Reads .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as source of truth; regenerates README's plugin table to include the new plugin without inventing a placeholder description; never writes to marketplace.json itself; invokes human-doc-reviewer afterward (mentions it explicitly, does not skip it).

evals.name: Non-trigger — a single plugin's own README
evals.prompt: Write docs for the git-kit plugin — update its own README.md with its current skill list.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as plugin-documentation's job (a single plugin's own docs), not marketplace-documentation's — does not attempt to read/regenerate the marketplace-root README's plugin table for this request.
